result.stdout:
Usage: dotnet atomui-license <command> [options]

Manage AtomUI commercial license credentials and deployment workflows.

Commands:
  activate     Activate a Developer license.
  status       Show local license status.
  refresh      Refresh the Developer Lease from local secure storage.
  deactivate   Deactivate the current Developer activation and clear local state.
  ci           Manage CI activation and Lease workflows.
  deployment   Create and issue deployment credentials.
  credential   Inspect offline credential files.
  revocations  Update the locally verified AtomUI revocation list.

Options:
  --json          Write one JSON result object to stdout.
  -h, --help      Show command help.
  --version       Show the CLI version.

result.stdout:
Usage: dotnet atomui-license activate [options]

Activate a Developer license.

Options:
  --server <https-uri>    Use the specified AtomUI License service.
  --license-key-stdin     Read the one-time License Key from standard input.
  --display-name <name>   Set the device display name.
  --discard-pending       Clear only an unavailable, unrecoverable pending request proof.
  --no-browser            Print the authorization URL without opening a browser.
  --replace               Replace an existing activation on this machine with another license.
  --json          Write one JSON result object to stdout.
  -h, --help      Show command help.
